blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The corporate counsel of GenCorp Industries Inc. on Wednesday testified that Vice President Sara Duterte had no shares or position in the corporation from 2022 to 2025. GenCorp counsel Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay was called to the witness stand to testify on Duterte’s involvement in GenCorp and Metro City Chow Foods Corp. Asked by defense counsel Justin Gular whether Duterte had shares or a position in GenCorp from 2022 to 2025, Balucanag-Punay repeatedly testified that the vice president held neither. “She has no stockholdings with GenCorp… She has no position,” she answered.
